## 一、Generator的实现及其示例

1、Generator的处理对象：CommandTree。

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f638970c2af4f51cdd0/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)

  


2、Generator的实现

|Generator|实现|目标|
|---|---|---|
|SelectGenerator|解析DbQueryCommandTree，转化Query表达式，保存成SelectStatement；,铺平三层同表嵌套，优化sql表达式。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f63a1ad9a3311dc4c43/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|InsertGenerator|解析DbInsertCommandTree，,首先解析tree._target（表名），保存statement.Target；,再遍历解析tree._setClauses集合（列名），保存statement.Sets；,重新遍历解析tree._setClauses集合（列值），保存statement.Values，Values保存占位符符？，绑定参数依赖generator的Parameter集合；,如果tree._returning不为null，则遍历查询列名，保存statement.ReturningSelect。,  
|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f63a1ad9a3311dc4c44/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|UpdateGenerator|解析DbUpdateCommandTree，,首先解析tree._target（表名），保存statement.Target；,再遍历解析tree._setClauses集合，保存statement.Properties（列名）和statement.Values（列值）；,再解析tree._predicate（筛选条件），保存statement.Where；,如果tree._returning不为null，则遍历查询列名，保存statement.ReturningSelect和RetruningType，用于存储过程绑定出参。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f63a1ad9a3311dc4c45/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DeleteGenerator|解析DbDeleteCommandTree，,首先解析tree._target（表名），保存statement.Target；,解析tree._predicate（筛选条件），保存statement.Where。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f638970c2af4f51cdd1/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|

2、Expression类图

|DbExpression|说明|结构|
|---|---|---|
|DbAndExpression|And表达式，存在left表达式和right表达式。,解析后：,{left} AND {right}|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f648970c2af4f51cdd2/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbApplyExpression|针对指定输入集中的每个元素调用指定函数。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c47/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbArithmeticExpression|用于数值参数的算术运算。,加法、减法、乘法、除法、模和否定是算术运算。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c48/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbCaseExpression|Case表达式。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f648970c2af4f51cdd3/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbCastExpression|类型转换。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c49/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbComparisonExpression|用于两个参数的比较操作。,相等、大于、大于或等于、小于、小于或等于和不等式是比较运算。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f648970c2af4f51cdd4/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbConstantExpression|常量。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f648970c2af4f51cdd5/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbCrossJoinExpression|集合之间的无条件联接操作。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c4a/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbDerefExpression|不支持|表示基于指定引用检索实体的表达式。|
|DbDistinctExpression|删除重复的元素。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c4b/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbElementExpression|将指定的集合转换为单列。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c4c/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbEntityRefExpression|从基础实体实例中提取引用。|mssql，mysql，oracle均不支持|
|DbExceptExpression|minus操作。左集合减右集合。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c4d/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbFilterExpression|筛选集合。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c4e/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbFunctionExpression|函数的调用。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f648970c2af4f51cdd6/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbGroupByExpression|分组运算。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f64a1ad9a3311dc4c4f/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbInExpression|指定项是否与列表中的任何元素匹配。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cdd7/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbIntersectExpression|INTERSECT操作。左集合和右集合之间的交集运算。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cdd8/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbIsEmptyExpression|是否空集合。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f65a1ad9a3311dc4c50/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbIsNullExpression|是否null值|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cdd9/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbIsOfExpression|表示单个参数与指定类型的类型比较|mssql，mysql,oracle均不支持。|
|DbJoinExpression|集合之间的inner join, left outer join 和 full outer join  操作。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cdda/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbLambdaExpression|允许将 lambda 函数应用于由对象表示的参数|mssql，mysql,oracle均不支持。|
|DbLikeExpression|字符串匹配。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f65a1ad9a3311dc4c51/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbLimitExpression|限制数量。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cddb/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbNewInstanceExpression|新集合构造。包含所有查询列的集合。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cddc/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbNotExpression|逻辑Not操作。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f65a1ad9a3311dc4c52/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbNullExpression|NULL值。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cddd/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbOfTypeExpression|表示从给定的 set 参数中检索指定类型的元素|mssql，mysql,oracle均不支持。|
|DbOrExpression|逻辑OR操作。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cdde/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbParameterReferenceExpression|参数。CommandTree上声明的参数。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cddf/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbProjectExpression|表达式整体。表示查询树根节点。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f65a1ad9a3311dc4c53/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbPropertiyExpression|实例属性。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cde0/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbQuantifierExpression|DbQuantifierExpression用来处理Any和All的表达式；,在EF6.0框架下，DbQuantifierExpression被翻译成Exists节点，    
  而Exists节点又会被翻译成DbNotExpression和DbIsEmptyExpression，    
  就导致一直使用不到DbQuantifierExpression。,  
  这个原因可能是因为6.0版本对any和all的逻辑优化，,其他版本的EF可能没有优化，就会使用到DbQuantifierExpression|mssql，oracle已实现，mysql未实现。,mssql，oracle对DbQuantifierExpression的实现一摸一样。|
|DbRefExpression|对实体集中特定实例的强类型引用。|mssql，mysql,oracle均不支持。|
|DbRefKeyExpression|将指定 Reference 的键值检索为一行。|mssql，mysql,oracle均不支持。|
|DbRelationshipNavigationExpression|关系导航。|mssql，mysql,oracle均不支持。|
|DbScanExpression|实体集快照。表名等信息。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f658970c2af4f51cde1/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbSkipExpression|跳过指定数量的元素。,只能在输入集合按照排序键指定的方式排序后使用。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f65a1ad9a3311dc4c54/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbSortExpression,  
,_col表示collate，指定排序规则；,数据库不支持。|排序操作。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f668970c2af4f51cde2/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbTreatExpression|应用于多态参数的类型转换操作|mssql，mysql,oracle均不支持。|
|DbUnionAllExpression|左集合和右集合之间的并集（不重复删除）操作。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f66a1ad9a3311dc4c55/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
|DbVariableReferenceExpression|变量的引用。|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67395f668970c2af4f51cde3/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-NTgxhtErCp862DzXrUgc3LLYA-iawZwTRec8cAlQz0)|
